field.name: Product Highlights
field.value: Women's lace-up ankle boots with a round toe, inner-side zipper and lug sole. The source specifies a PU upper and rubber outsole. Brown and Black are offered in the single-shoe version with size labels 35-40. Lining composition, insole, midsole and construction method are not specified for this version. Measurements, international size conversion, availability, packing and dispatch are confirmed for the order. Send quantities by color and size, destination and packing requirements for a quotation.
